2026 World Cup Final Tickets Price: Fans Ready to Pay Whopping Amount to Watch Lionel Messi's Argentina vs Lamine Yamal's Spain
2026 World Cup Final: So yes, we now have the two finalists - Spain and Argentina. While the game promises to be nothing short of a cracker, the exorbitant pricing has become the talk of the town.
SportFit- 2 min read
2026 World Cup Final: So yes, we now have the two finalists - Spain and Argentina. While the game promises to be nothing short of a cracker, the exorbitant pricing has become the talk of the town. The prices have hit the roof and experts believe the much-awaited final would generate massive revenue as well. The cheapest individual ticket on StubHub was $7,868, which roughly amounts to eight lakh in rupees. And that's before factoring in the price of potential flights, hotels, transportation and food during the stay.
Exorbitant Prices
It is clear that the resale market has contributed to the ridiculous costs.
"When World Cup organizers FIFA first put tickets on sale last October, prices were already the highest in World Cup history. Then, over the months that followed, FIFA raised them using a 'variable pricing' scheme—also known as dynamic pricing. ... For instance, FIFA's Category 1 prices in the 2026 group stage, excluding openers, range from $450 to $990. In 2022, the same tickets cost $220. Category 1 tickets for the 2026 quarterfinals cost at least $1,360—up from $425 at the last World Cup," Henry Bushnell, Emily Giambalvo and Jonah Smith of The Athletic reported a month ago.
Advertisement
It is clear that the world would go to any extent to get their hands on the tickets and Messi is a big factor. When Messi takes centre stage during the upcoming final against Spain, the match could very well be his last in an Argentine shirt. It will be interesting to see who has the last laugh when the dominant Spaniards try to prevent Lionel Messi from leading his country to a second straight title.
